# Record: docs/benchmarks/static-relro-2026-11-02/.
# Earlier startup-only implementation, superseded by the record above:
# 2026-11-02: SEC-028 (#13530), from a local profile-costs run. The constant boxes, aggregates and address
# tables move to .data.rel.ro and _start maps them read-only. Every .emit row grows by the 50 lines of the
# protection block, and the .ir rows by the auxv scan and the mprotect call. The .bytes rows move with the
# layout: the data bytes follow the code in the file, so an arm64 image loses its 64 KiB of load-alignment
# padding, and an x86-64 image moves by at most one page in either direction.
# 2026-11-01: PR #14009 retains main's limits wherever the initial report grew.
# Source corrections must pass those limits. Improved rows keep their measured lower pins.

# and __fern_buf_push takes a direct path: enum_match.*.ir -40% to -49%, deflate_decode.*.ir -1.9% to
# -13.4%, http_hello.*.ir -1.8% to -2.6%, and http_hello.*.emit +1.2% to +1.35% on the native targets.
